definitionZh: padding-block CSS 的短手属性定义了元素的逻辑块始末的padding,根据元素的写法模式,方向,以及文本方向,将它映射到物理的padding属性.
sourceDefinition: The padding-block CSS shorthand property defines the logical block start and end padding of an element, which maps to physical padding properties depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation.
